items.difficulty_reason: Every dg module admits a quasi-isomorphism from a good one, and the author gives TWO complete proofs in this region. First proof (3199-3261): start from the sheaf of graded sets of cycles S_0, map the free module P_0 = A[S_0] onto M, and iterate through the admissible short exact sequences 0 -> P_i -> P_{i+1} -> A[S_{i+1}] -> 0, concluding goodness via the direct-sum lemma. Second proof, explicitly marked Second proof (3263-3442): resolve by short exact sequences 0 -> M_{i+1} -> P_i -> M_i -> 0 with the maps chosen as in lemma-good-quotient and build P as the total complex of the resulting double complex with d_P(x) = f_{-a}(x) + (-1)^a d(x). Per LANE_BRIEF 10.2/16.5 the card retains BOTH proof environments. Retained author proof at lines 3199-3442 (9551 bytes total).
